# Video-to-motion service (MoCapAnything V2). torch is NOT listed here: it is
# installed afterwards by run_server, against the CUDA build select_torch.py
# picks for the machine. Anything that pulls torch in from PyPI would drag a CPU
# build in first and win.
#
# Versions are deliberately loose. The upstream repo pins transformers==4.57.1
# and numpy<2, but the only transformers symbols this code touches are
# AutoImageProcessor, Dinov2Model, T5EncoderModel and T5Tokenizer — all present
# in 5.x — and there are no numpy-2-removed aliases anywhere in the tree. Keeping
# the range open is what allows this service to share an environment with the
# rigging service (see README.md, "Sharing an environment").

# --- inference ---------------------------------------------------------------
transformers>=4.57
numpy>=1.26
opencv-python
pillow
scipy
scikit-image
matplotlib
trimesh
roma
einops
sentencepiece          # T5Tokenizer is the sentencepiece one
huggingface_hub
pyyaml
tqdm
imageio-ffmpeg         # bundles an ffmpeg binary; no system ffmpeg needed

# --- the service itself ------------------------------------------------------
fastapi
uvicorn
python-multipart

# --- the per-rig bake --------------------------------------------------------
# Blender as an importable module, so no separate Blender install is required.
# Only published for CPython 3.11 and 3.13 — there is NO 3.12 wheel — which is
# why run_server provisions 3.13. Large (~323 MB).
#
# If this is unavailable on your platform the service falls back to a Blender
# executable found on PATH (or $BLENDER); see mocap_paths.find_blender.
bpy>=5.1; python_version >= "3.13"
